operations.completion: An identifiable candidate is chosen from a nonempty set available at choice time.
operations.required_context: Candidate identity; choice time; selection rule may be implicit. A quality claim additionally needs its criterion.
operations.distinction: Creation supplies a candidate the initial inventory lacked. Search, explicit ranking and optimality are not universal selection requirements.

operations.completion: A new instance is constructed relative to an explicit initial inventory.
operations.required_context: What counts as a new instance; required result.
operations.distinction: Retrieval locates an earlier instance; renaming creates no new instance of the named target.

operations.completion: An identified instance receives a changed version.
operations.required_context: Earlier instance; changed feature; version identity.
operations.distinction: Comparison determines differences but does not produce the revision.

operations.completion: The target's content or requirements are made explicit.
operations.distinction: Specification can describe an existing target; it does not necessarily create that target.

operations.completion: A description or observation is matched to the target it denotes.
operations.distinction: Selection chooses what to use, not what the description refers to.

operations.completion: Conditions for being the same specified target are established or applied.
operations.distinction: Similar contribution does not establish identity.

operations.completion: An approach's operating conditions are checked against a case.
operations.distinction: An applicable approach need not be the preferred one.

operations.completion: Differences or ordering are established under fixed comparison conditions.
operations.distinction: Choosing or changing an item requires a further determination.

operations.completion: Grounds are established for the stated criterion or commitment.
operations.distinction: Observed endorsement is not sufficient justification.

operations.completion: An identified target is expressed through a specified form or correspondence.
operations.distinction: The expression is not automatically the thing it represents.

operations.completion: A representation changes form under an explicit content correspondence.
operations.required_context: Source form; destination form; fidelity requirement.
operations.distinction: Modification need not preserve the represented content.

operations.completion: An already retained target is located.
operations.required_context: Retrieval target; retained corpus; matching conditions.
operations.distinction: A failure to retrieve is not proof that the target never existed.

operations.completion: An earlier target is rebuilt from surviving traces.
operations.required_context: Earlier target; surviving evidence; inferred portions.
operations.distinction: Reconstruction need not be verbatim recovery.

operations.completion: An identified target remains available across an interval or transition.
operations.distinction: Availability does not demonstrate subsequent use.

operations.completion: Specified operations are actually performed on supplied material.
operations.distinction: A procedure description is not an execution.

operations.completion: A representation or performance preserves its specified reference.
operations.distinction: Faithful execution does not by itself establish usefulness.

operations.completion: A proposed contribution meets an identified requirement.
operations.distinction: Approval or novelty is insufficient evidence of adequacy.

operations.completion: A specified consequence relation holds under fixed inference rules.
operations.distinction: Valid inference does not establish that its premises are true.

operations.completion: An admissible case refutes the stated universal claim.
operations.required_context: Exact universal; domain; true antecedent; false consequent.
operations.distinction: A caution compatible with the universal is not a counterexample.

operations.completion: A specified defect or cause of failure is located.
operations.required_context: Observed failure; expected result; competing accounts.
operations.distinction: Calling an outcome bad does not locate its cause.

operations.completion: An identified defect is addressed by a specified replacement.
operations.distinction: A correction can be proposed without proving later uptake.

operations.completion: A changed item is better under a fixed baseline and standard.
operations.required_context: Baseline; changed item; criterion; comparison conditions.
operations.distinction: Modification is a process; improvement here is a comparative relation.

operations.completion: A specified condition or ability is preserved through an interval or disturbance.
operations.required_context: Preserved property; interval; disturbance; acceptable variation.
operations.distinction: Preservation can succeed without creating a new ability.

operations.completion: A stated result or ability continues to hold in a specified changed setting.
operations.required_context: Source context; target context; preserved relation.
operations.distinction: Repeated wording is not evidence of transfer.

operations.completion: A rule determines when further performance should end.
operations.distinction: Termination need not mean successful completion.

operations.completion: The cases or interpretations covered by a specified assertion or subject are fixed.
operations.distinction: A broad noun does not specify its intended extension by itself.

operations.completion: What a stated resource, warrant, or capacity fails to establish is identified.
operations.required_context: Fixed target; applicable conditions; limiting relation.
operations.distinction: A support limit is not a truth condition.

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Refinement or split; not blanket equivalence

name_changes.relation: Ambiguous proposal; split by intended relation
name_changes.reason: Truth-making situations, warrant limits, and claim application conditions answer different questions. The old A2 definition primarily concerns warrant; it does not define a truth boundary.

name_changes.relation: Same specified determination; one canonical row
name_changes.reason: Both draft definitions derived a consequence from identified premises under fixed inference rules. A different prefix was not a new subject.

name_changes.relation: Generalized mechanism question; earlier human-internal case retained as qualification
name_changes.reason: The older definition asked how an agent transforms an internal representation. Preserve that mechanism question while admitting other specified implementations; this is not blanket scope equivalence.

boundary_cases.case: Choosing A from an existing set leaves the set unchanged; inventing C enlarges it without choosing C.
boundary_cases.consequence: Specify the initial candidate set and identity rule; a workflow can do both.

boundary_cases.case: Changing A into A2 is modification; A2 can also count as newly created if version identity is the classified target.
boundary_cases.consequence: Do not declare process classes disjoint. Fix whether the subject asks for a new approach identity or a revised version; otherwise mark the request composite or unresolved.

boundary_cases.case: A revision can be made without showing any benefit; the unchanged pair can be compared without revising either.
boundary_cases.consequence: Keep production of the version separate from the verdict about it.

boundary_cases.case: The criterion can change while the chosen approach remains A; the choice can change under one unchanged criterion.
boundary_cases.consequence: The shared name prefix is not sufficient proof that choosing is a genus of criterion formation.

boundary_cases.case: A faithful execution can produce an irrelevant contribution; a departure can supply the required contribution.
boundary_cases.consequence: Record what was followed separately from what was accomplished.

boundary_cases.case: Two approaches satisfy their assumptions while only one is selected under cost constraints.
boundary_cases.consequence: Applicability removes an objection; it does not uniquely select a method.

boundary_cases.case: Choose to construct a counterexample, then choose which approach will construct it.
boundary_cases.consequence: The contribution kind is held fixed only in approach selection.

boundary_cases.case: A proposition retains its truth conditions when a supporting source is withdrawn; its warrant changes.
boundary_cases.consequence: Do not rename support limits as truth boundaries.

boundary_cases.case: Fix what an assertion says, then determine whether a summary preserves it.
boundary_cases.consequence: Interpretation of the source is input to the fidelity comparison.

boundary_cases.case: A record expresses high confidence even though its stated grounds do not meet the acceptance threshold.
boundary_cases.consequence: Reported confidence and warrant require separate evidence.

boundary_cases.case: A counterexample establishes invalidity, but validity can be assessed without constructing such a case.
boundary_cases.consequence: Link the contribution to the assessment; do not infer that all validity investigations are counterexample construction.

boundary_cases.case: Both draft definitions produce a consequence from the same premises under the same rules.
boundary_cases.consequence: Remove the duplicate canonical entry; preserve the alternate name in Name Changes.

boundary_cases.case: Two wordings can ask the same question while a supplied response answers a different one.
boundary_cases.consequence: Question identity is fixed before judging that response's fit.

boundary_cases.case: A partially responsive answer has some fit while leaving one required distinction unresolved.
boundary_cases.consequence: Completeness refines the coverage aspect of fit. These must not be claimed as disjoint siblings.

boundary_cases.case: An answer-dependent next-step rule is both a question-route rule and a plan contingency.
boundary_cases.consequence: The qualified route view is not a second independent matter. Record the target specialization; do not choose a home merely by project name.

boundary_cases.case: An agent selects a preferred candidate goal while postponing undertaking it.
boundary_cases.consequence: Choosing the candidate and establishing the undertaking have different state changes.

boundary_cases.case: A repository update completes while the goal that corrected understanding affects later work remains unachieved.
boundary_cases.consequence: Use the specified goal conditions and activity completion conditions separately.

boundary_cases.case: Observed dislike of a name supports a preference account without proving that everyone should reject that name.
boundary_cases.consequence: Descriptive favoring is not normative justification.

boundary_cases.case: An intact file is located; a missing paragraph is separately reconstructed from surviving versions.
boundary_cases.consequence: Identify whether the requested result is an existing record or an inferred reconstruction.

boundary_cases.case: A rejected decision is retrieved with its status, then incorrectly used as current.
boundary_cases.consequence: Recovered status does not establish faithful later use.

boundary_cases.case: Retrieving an old question is new to the current inquiry but preserves an older item's identity.
boundary_cases.consequence: Novelty and historical recovery are different assertions about the episode, not disjoint event classes.

boundary_cases.case: Constructing a run record is a form of creating an expression of the run.
boundary_cases.consequence: Treat the execution-record target as a specialization; do not assert unrelated exclusive branches.

boundary_cases.case: Using a previously grasped relation in a new format is one kind of capability transfer.
boundary_cases.consequence: The qualified understanding target narrows the capability matter; it does not become an exclusive peer of all capability.

boundary_cases.case: An agent adapts by using a grasped relation in a new task; one performance bears on both scopes.
boundary_cases.consequence: No exclusive Intelligence/Understanding partition has been established. These are overlapping aspects under Capability until definitions or units change.

boundary_cases.case: A stored correction can fail to affect the next applicable action.
boundary_cases.consequence: Inspect later use rather than certifying learning from storage.

boundary_cases.case: A learned habit can worsen performance; an artifact repair can improve without experiential learning.
boundary_cases.consequence: Betterment and experience-dependent origin are different relations.

boundary_cases.case: A producer and consumer agree on meaning but lack capacity to run jointly; capacity can also be ample while meanings conflict.
boundary_cases.consequence: Semantic contract compatibility and allocation feasibility vary independently.

boundary_cases.case: When a consumer interprets an instruction, interface meaning and recipient interpretation can describe the same mismatch.
boundary_cases.consequence: Do not certify exclusion for this pair. Derive whether a particular contract mismatch is the same attributed-interpretation matter or a different formal contract relation.

boundary_cases.case: One row locates the invalid step; the other explains which approach feature caused the failure.
boundary_cases.consequence: A location report is not a causal explanation of that failure.

boundary_cases.case: A class can fail to include another while still sharing instances with it.
boundary_cases.consequence: Not-a-subtype does not entail disjointness.

boundary_cases.case: No candidate is available: availability can be determined negatively while successful selection is impossible.
boundary_cases.consequence: Do not require a positive availability result merely to investigate availability.

boundary_cases.case: A user supplies the candidate directly; the selector can choose it without a separate retrieval step.
boundary_cases.consequence: Retrieval is one route to satisfying availability; selection need not contain it.

boundary_cases.relation: Distinct defined target; mechanism equivalence unsupported
boundary_cases.case: A matrix weight calculation and a person choosing what to attend to can each be examined without the other.
boundary_cases.consequence: Shared wording does not establish subject or mechanism identity.

boundary_cases.case: Compute a rotation exactly without observing any person; measure a matching response without uniquely identifying the internal process.
boundary_cases.consequence: Keep mathematical specification, cognitive explanation and measurement distinct.

boundary_cases.relation: Shared semantic cases; additional nonsemantic conditions
boundary_cases.case: Producer and consumer agree on units and meanings, but a missed timing deadline prevents a specified interface exchange.
boundary_cases.consequence: Interpretation alignment alone is insufficient for general interface compatibility.

boundary_cases.relation: Different determination and qualified resource context
boundary_cases.case: Choose records to retain without yet retaining them; a mechanism can retain a record without deciding whether it is worth keeping.
boundary_cases.consequence: Retention choice and the occurrence of retention require different results.

boundary_cases.case: An authorized rule can have no intended effect; an unauthorized action can still change outcomes.
boundary_cases.consequence: Authority and causal success must be judged separately.

boundary_cases.case: An urgent matter can receive little effort while a low-consequence matter receives much.
boundary_cases.consequence: Underrepresentation needs both a measured effort allocation and a justified comparison standard.

boundary_cases.case: An image operation returns the rotated coordinates; it need not identify how a human rotates an internal representation.
boundary_cases.consequence: Keep both determinations, with the human-internal mechanism as a qualified case.

boundary_cases.case: An observer identifies an agent's expectation from behavior without constructing a new forecast.
boundary_cases.consequence: The same episode may support both inquiries; their requested results remain different.

boundary_cases.case: A rare contingency can merit preparation while another outcome is expected.
boundary_cases.consequence: Neither expectation nor preparation entails the other.

boundary_cases.case: A backup becomes cheaper while the event probability stays fixed; the preparation changes alone.
boundary_cases.consequence: The earlier broad revision label is split before admission.

boundary_cases.case: A newly visible alternative improves the original task; in another case a verdict changes only because the goal changed.
boundary_cases.consequence: A changed criterion can be justified but does not establish contribution to the original fixed goal.

boundary_cases.relation: Related determinations; no general containment asserted
boundary_cases.case: A changed perspective changes a descriptive classification without producing any improvement claim.
boundary_cases.consequence: The broad perspective verdict question does not universally fall within apparent-improvement diagnosis.

boundary_cases.case: The ordering relation is componentwise weak superiority with strictness on at least one admitted criterion.
boundary_cases.consequence: Keep the explicit broader-subject link; do not present these as exclusive siblings.

boundary_cases.case: A distractor disrupts maintained content without any long-term record retrieval being the target.
boundary_cases.consequence: Qualify the memory process; one episode can contain both effects.

boundary_cases.relation: Control against competitors versus overall maintenance process
boundary_cases.case: A maintenance account can concern rehearsal without a competing-content manipulation; interference control requires that particular causal comparison.
boundary_cases.consequence: Treat interference control as a refinement of the maintenance question, not an exclusive alternative branch.

boundary_cases.relation: Unfilled scope versus rival specified readings
boundary_cases.case: A label leaves the rotation frame unstated; another label permits two fully specified different rotation operations.
boundary_cases.consequence: Record the actual missing parameter or rival readings. If one case poses both determinations, it is two matters in one case.

boundary_cases.relation: Construction versus assessment of required content
boundary_cases.case: One creates an approach description; the other finds an unresolved execution choice in an existing description.
boundary_cases.consequence: Do not treat a detailed description as its own completeness evidence.

boundary_cases.relation: Unhandled case versus incompatible applicable rules
boundary_cases.case: A gate can have no matching rule for an input; another gate can have two conflicting matching rules.
boundary_cases.consequence: Coverage and consistency require separate findings.

boundary_cases.case: The same enumeration method is used on a different finite domain while its earlier domain count does not transfer.
boundary_cases.consequence: Retain the method/result distinction.

boundary_cases.case: Two orders produce different arithmetic results; identifying which order a plan requires needs an intended result.
boundary_cases.consequence: A fact about order effects does not by itself prescribe an order.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Holding hormone identity fixed while varying the receiving configuration separates ligand identity from the whole response arrangement.
boundary_cases.consequence: One causal episode can support different bearer attributions for different explanatory targets. Assigning consciousness, goals or all downstream effects to the named component.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A fixed threshold rule produces different heater states above and below the threshold without acquiring a new rule.
boundary_cases.consequence: Response variation can occur under an unchanged governing configuration. The bearer consciously noticing the difference or its response being beneficial.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Two lookup tables agree on familiar cases but disagree on an altered wording case.
boundary_cases.consequence: Agreement on the present answer can coexist with different later activation or transfer behavior. Identity of mechanisms, experience, cost or behavior outside the domain.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A new input changes an unchanged rule's output; a revised threshold changes the rule; a sensor repair changes access.
boundary_cases.consequence: Input, state, access and rule changes have different implications. Attributing improvement, causal sufficiency or intentional revision from the changed result alone.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: The same failed transfer appears as missing content or missing application-condition recognition.
boundary_cases.consequence: Problem recognition is part of perspective development rather than an invariably correct supplied input. The choice to act on a recognized problem or a difference caused solely by new presented evidence.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Success after a minimal cue directs inquiry toward recognition; failure reopens missing content or operation.
boundary_cases.consequence: Relevance is a contribution relation whose conditions can change as results arrive. Technique selection, truth of the result or relevance inferred only from topic similarity.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A cue observation precedes interpretation of transfer failure and selection of a case contrast or missing-operation study.
boundary_cases.consequence: Selecting subjects does not determine how their contributions are composed. An unordered subject list, automatic truth of outputs or proof of overall effectiveness.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Cue success supports recognition inquiry; cue failure reopens content or operation; an unperformed test leaves both open.
boundary_cases.consequence: Unknown must have its own continuation and must not silently become success or failure. Producing the study result or establishing the interpretation rule's truth.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A matched positive and negative case exposes when an already executable method applies.
boundary_cases.consequence: A transition can first create the conditions needed for a useful perspective. Merely naming the destination or assuming the operation necessarily succeeds.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A contrasting-case operation needs accessible cases; knowing its name does not supply them.
boundary_cases.consequence: Creating a prerequisite can change transition applicability. Actual transition success, retention or suitability of the destination.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Transfer failure leads through a cue observation and case contrast to an application-condition perspective.
boundary_cases.consequence: A perspective can contribute through its accessible continuations before it supplies the final result. Reachability through unknown operations, successful real execution or a universally optimal route.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A saved instruction survives while a later task still receives the irrelevant operation it was intended to replace.
boundary_cases.consequence: Record persistence and retention of a usable improvement are different determinations. Establishing the original benefit, immediate repetition alone or assuming a saved note is used.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A new diagram makes a dependency distinction available before anyone chooses to use it.
boundary_cases.consequence: Formation can depend on conditions external to the eventual bearer. Later activation of an available perspective or universal necessity of one origin.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Familiar wording activates a method while different wording conceals the same governing relation.
boundary_cases.consequence: An activation cue can be narrower than the perspective's application domain. Its construction, conscious choice or suitability for the context.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: A retrieval interpretation directs a cue test without licensing a final diagnosis.
boundary_cases.consequence: Productive trial use does not require settled truth or final adoption. Evidence-warranted confidence or commitment attributed to every physical bearer.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: An agent promises an application-condition comparison but produces another general explanation.
boundary_cases.consequence: Declared, enacted and attributed perspectives can differ without establishing deception or pathology. A diagnosis, a hidden true self, complete introspective access or truth of the declared account.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Identical current method choices differ in whether recognition survives a wording change.
boundary_cases.consequence: Content and activation conditions vary independently in the constructed case. Renaming an existing dimension or adding a label without a separating case.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Three interpretations, two representations and two commitments produce twelve assignments before exclusions.
boundary_cases.consequence: A construction space exposes omissions relative to its rules while leaving missing dimensions open. All possible perspectives being captured or every combination being semantically adequate.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Content, retrieval and representation interpretations omit application-condition recognition in an altered case.
boundary_cases.consequence: Complete enumeration of current combinations can coexist with a substantive coverage gap. Universal perspective completeness or coverage by one individual perspective.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: An interpretation unsuitable for final reliance can still expose a useful missing condition when tried temporarily.
boundary_cases.consequence: Exclusion from action and exclusion from exploration can require different grounds. Permanent rejection, falsity of every candidate claim or final perspective selection.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: An exploratory assumption enters execution as established, losing its conditional standing.
boundary_cases.consequence: Composition must preserve contribution roles and status. Mere component count, independent component failure or automatic incompatibility of different viewpoints.

boundary_cases.relation: Specified target distinction; see perspective development for the scope of any shared case.
boundary_cases.case: Application-condition work transfers to another topic only if the relation governing appropriate use is preserved.
boundary_cases.consequence: A reusable transition can transfer while the earlier task answer does not. Shared wording, retention only in the original setting or benefit in every related case.

expansion_families.reason: An approach has identity, operating conditions, executions, outputs, and an operative inventory.
expansion_families.limit: Improvement needs a baseline and criterion; a universal best approach is not assumed.

expansion_families.reason: A response can address different portions of a requested distinction or resolve a faulty presupposition.
expansion_families.limit: Answer creation is not truth creation. Truth still requires the substantive claim's determination.

expansion_families.reason: Grounds can support a claim in different ways, share a dependency, or survive one corrected premise.
expansion_families.limit: Truth is not inferred from acceptance; confidence is not manufactured as a probability.

expansion_families.reason: A represented content and form can vary separately; changing form exposes preservation questions.
expansion_families.limit: No literal truth modification: changing the expression is not changing the represented fact.

expansion_families.reason: A record has an earlier source and consequential context that retrieval alone may fail to preserve.
expansion_families.limit: No retrieval of a never-created item; construct it instead if the task permits.

expansion_families.reason: Components exchange results with meanings, required conditions, and dependent consumers.
expansion_families.limit: Matching names is insufficient; automatic integration of every pair is not a defined capability.

expansion_families.reason: Adaptive ability can increase, persist, or decline under comparable conditions.
expansion_families.limit: Maintaining intelligence need not involve learning or creation.

expansion_families.reason: A subject admits specified matters; these create explicit positive and negative membership questions.
expansion_families.limit: Unique IDs or a large name count do not prove an exclusive complete hierarchy.

expansion_families.reason: Develop bearer attribution, relevance, transition and construction matters beyond the prior perspective scope.
expansion_families.limit: Distinct determinations are not disjoint kinds of whole entities; the general account remains a proposal.

hierarchy_standing: The canonical named inventory is expanded. Target groups are partial scope unions; lexical nesting is not a proof of subtype or exclusion. The case review finds aliases, specializations, and unresolved overlaps, so the 28 headings are not presented as a perfected set of exclusive roots.
closed_domain: The 28 predecessor scopes, the 21 recorded source-family profiles, the current naming request, and the explicitly defined extensions in Subject Names.
unresolved: The exact Master Framework source remains unresolved.
Intelligence and Understanding can overlap as capability aspects.
System interface compatibility versus recipient interpretation needs the specified interface case.
A complete ontology of every possible subject is not a finite enumeration established by this inventory.
Autophilosophy conceptual investigation does not identify its particular conceptual target; one of the 63 contribution records therefore has no asserted exact subject binding.
